backend/main.mo: Main actor defining SemenStraw and Sale types with CRUD operations including addOrUpdateStraw with colorCode field, createSale, status updates, and query functions for straws, sales, and generating sale bills.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms OldSemenStraw records (without colorCode) to NewSemenStraw records (with colorCode defaulting to 'unknown') while preserving sales and nextSaleId state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five implemented features: color code input in AddStrawForm, color code editing in EditStrawForm, color code display in InventoryTable, bill generation button in SalesHistory, and BillView component for formatted invoices.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of 13 frontend files covering routing, layout, dashboard, inventory management with color codes, sales dialogs, sales history with bill generation, and styling configuration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes, including agricultural-themed color palette and design tokens for UI components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with viewport meta tag, app title 'Semen Straw Business App', root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring QueryClient, TanStack Router with routes for Dashboard (/) and SalesHistory (/sales), Layout wrapper, and Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/AddStrawForm.tsx: Form component for adding new semen straw records with fields including strawId, bullId, collectionDate, quality, storageLocation, quantity, and colorCode; validates inputs and calls useAddStraw mutation.
frontend/src/components/BillView.tsx: Invoice display component that fetches sale bill data using useGenerateSaleBill hook, renders formatted invoice with business header, buyer info, itemized straw details including color code, and print functionality.
frontend/src/components/EditStrawForm.ts: Form component for editing semen straw records with fields for bull ID, collection date, quality, storage location, quantity, color code, and status. Handles validation and uses mutations to update straw data and status separately.
frontend/src/components/InventoryFilters: Filter component providing search input for Bull ID/Straw ID and a status dropdown filter (All/Available/Sold/Used). Displays filters in a card layout with responsive grid.
frontend/src/components/InventoryTable.t: Table component displaying semen straw inventory with columns for ID, bull ID, collection date, quality, storage, color code, quantity, and status. Includes edit and sell action buttons with dialog modals and empty state handling.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with header navigation (Dashboard/Sales History links), footer with branding, and outlet for nested routes. Uses TanStack Router for navigation state.
frontend/src/components/SaleDialog.tsx: Dialog form for recording semen straw sales with fields for sale date, buyer information, quantity sold, and price. Validates quantity against available stock and creates sale records via mutation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Invalidates dependent queries when actor changes due to identity updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity state, and AuthClient lifecycle. Provides authentication status and identity to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating semen straw and sales data, including operations like getAllStraws, addStraw, updateStraw, createSale, and generating bills.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom agricultural-themed color palette using OKLCH color space, defining light and dark mode CSS variables for UI components.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main inventory dashboard page displaying filterable/searchable semen straw table with add new straw dialog functionality.
frontend/src/pages/SalesHistory.tsx: Sales history page showing a table of all recorded sales transactions with bill generation functionality via dialog.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, typography, animations, and container settings for the agricultural-themed UI.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking implemented features for a semen straw business management app, including inventory management, sales recording, and UI theming requirements.
